faqs.q: Where are you located and is there parking?
faqs.a: We're at 1899 NE 164th St, North Miami Beach, Florida 33162. Free parking is available for patients.
Monday to Friday 9 AM to 5:30 PM, Saturday 9 AM to 1 PM, and closed Sunday.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: I can take your name and phone number and have the team call you to schedule, or you can call (305) 864-1373 during office hours.

faqs.q: Do you take insurance? How much does it cost?
faqs.a: I don't have pricing or insurance details. I can have the office call you with specifics.
If this is a medical emergency, hang up and call 911 now. If you're in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988.
